name: Mind Extraction
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Target player reveals their hand and discards all cards of each of the sacrificed creature's colors.

name: Captivating Glance
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
At the beginning of your end step, clash with an opponent. If you win, gain control of enchanted creature. Otherwise, that player gains control of enchanted creature. (Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts that card on their choice of the top or bottom. A player wins if their card had a greater mana value.)

name: Cinderheart Giant
oracle_text:
Trample
When this creature dies, it deals 7 damage to a creature an opponent controls chosen at random.
flavor_text: What fire giants lack in arcane prowess, they make up for with reckless, explosive rage.

name: Scab-Clan Giant
oracle_text: When this creature enters, it fights target creature an opponent controls chosen at random.
flavor_text: For the Gruul, bone-crushing rage is the first priority. Accuracy comes in a distant ninetieth.

name: Mesmeric Sliver
oracle_text: All Slivers have "When this permanent enters, you may fateseal 1." (To fateseal 1, its controller looks at the top card of an opponent's library, then they may put that card on the bottom of that library.)

name: Vendilion Clique
oracle_text:
Flash
Flying
When Vendilion Clique enters, look at target player's hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player reveals the chosen card, puts it on the bottom of their library, then draws a card.

name: Cracked Skull
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, look at target player's hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
When enchanted creature is dealt damage, destroy it.
flavor_text: Ears ringing and head throbbing, all Tarvin could do was wait to see what would finish the job.

name: Goblin Test Pilot
oracle_text:
Flying
{T}: This creature deals 2 damage to any target chosen at random.
flavor_text:
"All pilots and prototypes destroyed. Extensive collateral damage inflicted. Conclusion: flawless design."
—*Manual of Melek*

name: Spin into Myth
oracle_text: Put target creature on top of its owner's library, then fateseal 2. (To fateseal 2, look at the top two cards of an opponent's library, then put any number of them on the bottom of that player's library and the rest on top in any order.)

name: Hint of Insanity
oracle_text: Target player reveals their hand. That player discards all nonland cards with the same name as another card in their hand.
flavor_text: "Practice makes perfect, but obsession makes better."

name: Thought Distortion
oracle_text:
This spell can't be countered.
Target opponent reveals their hand. Exile all noncreature, nonland cards from that player's hand and graveyard.
flavor_text:
"The skull is rigid, but the mind is so deliciously supple."
—Eromena the Mind Render

name: Rag Man
oracle_text: {B}{B}{B}, {T}: Target opponent reveals their hand and discards a creature card at random. Activate only during your turn.
flavor_text: He hunts what might have been.

name: Dreams of Steel and Oil
oracle_text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an artifact or creature card from it, then choose an artifact or creature card from their graveyard. Exile the chosen cards.
flavor_text: Mishra's nightmares of Phyrexia rang with screams of agony and groans of twisted metal. The sounds stayed with him long after he awoke.

name: Oildeep Gearhulk
oracle_text:
Lifelink, ward {1}
When this creature enters, look at target player's hand. You may choose a card from it. If you do, that player discards that card, then draws a card.
flavor_text: Oil-actuated inventions raised eyebrows after the Invasion, but no one could argue against the efficacy of the design.

name: Gilt-Leaf Ambush
oracle_text: Create two 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature tokens. Clash with an opponent. If you win, those creatures gain deathtouch until end of turn. (Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts that card on their choice of the top or bottom. A player wins if their card had a greater mana value. Any amount of damage a creature with deathtouch deals to a creature is enough to destroy it.)
